# Angular API Integration Standards

**Load at**: Module 7 (Service Implementation) — with `angular-service-standards.instructions.md`
**Applies to**: All HTTP API integration generated by the `angular-ui` agent
**Angular Version**: 21

---

## 1. HttpClient Setup

In Angular 21 standalone apps, provide `HttpClient` in `app.config.ts`:
```typescript
import { provideHttpClient, withInterceptors } from '@angular/common/http';
import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideHttpClient(
      withInterceptors([authInterceptor, loggingInterceptor])
    ),
  ]
};
```

In NgModule apps (legacy):
```typescript
import { HttpClientModule } from '@angular/common/http';

@NgModule({
  imports: [HttpClientModule]
})
```

---

## 2. Project-Specific API Pattern (LoanService)

**Base URL**: `http://localhost:8081/api/loan`

This project uses a **className-based dispatch pattern** where all operations go to a single endpoint and the `className` field determines the operation type.

### Common Request Structure
All requests include:
```typescript
interface LoanApiRequest {
  className: string;           // Determines operation type
  transaction: string;         // e.g., "LoanPrincipalPayment"
  [key: string]: any;          // Operation-specific fields
}
```

### Create Principal Payment
```typescript
createPrincipalPayment(request: CreateLoanPrincipalPaymentRequest): Observable<any> {
  const payload = {
    className: 'CreateLoanPrincipalPaymentIntegration',
    transaction: 'LoanPrincipalPayment',
    requestedAmount: request.requestedAmount,
    effectiveDate: request.effectiveDate,
    eventComment: request.eventComment,
    transactionDescription: request.transactionDescription,
    preventOnlineDeletionIndicator: request.preventOnlineDeletionIndicator ?? 'N',
    loanAlias: request.loanAlias,
    loanId: request.loanId,
    suppressBreakfunding: request.suppressBreakfunding ?? 'N',
    transactionDate: request.transactionDate,
    systemSourceId: request.systemSourceId,
    sourceRefNum: request.sourceRefNum,
    autoReduceFacility: request.autoReduceFacility ?? 'N'
  };
  
  return this.http.post<any>(this.baseUrl, payload);
}
```

### Query Principal Payment
```typescript
queryPrincipalPayment(loanTransactionId: string): Observable<any> {
  const payload = {
    className: 'GetLoanPrincipalPaymentIntegration',
    transaction: 'LoanPrincipalPayment',
    loanTransactionId
  };
  
  // Note: This API uses POST/GET with body (non-standard pattern)
  return this.http.get<any>(this.baseUrl, { 
    params: new HttpParams()
      .set('className', payload.className)
      .set('transaction', payload.transaction)
      .set('loanTransactionId', payload.loanTransactionId)
  });
}
```

### Update Principal Payment
```typescript
updatePrincipalPayment(request: UpdateLoanPrincipalPaymentRequest): Observable<any> {
  const payload = {
    className: 'UpdateLoanPrincipalPaymentIntegration',
    transaction: 'LoanPrincipalPayment',
    requestedAmount: request.requestedAmount,
    effectiveDate: request.effectiveDate,
    loanTransactionId: request.loanTransactionId,
    preventOnlineDeletionIndicator: request.preventOnlineDeletionIndicator ?? 'N',
    eventComment: request.eventComment,
    transactionDescription: request.transactionDescription,
    loanAlias: request.loanAlias,
    loanId: request.loanId,
    suppressBreakfunding: request.suppressBreakfunding ?? 'N',
    transactionDate: request.transactionDate,
    systemSourceId: request.systemSourceId,
    sourceRefNum: request.sourceRefNum,
    applyToEarliestItem: request.applyToEarliestItem ?? 'N',
    scheduleDate: request.scheduleDate,
    autoReduceFacility: request.autoReduceFacility ?? ''
  };
  
  return this.http.put<any>(this.baseUrl, payload);
}
```

### Delete Principal Payment
```typescript
deletePrincipalPayment(loanTransactionId: string): Observable<void> {
  const payload = {
    className: 'DeleteLoanPrincipalPaymentIntegration',
    transaction: 'LoanPrincipalPayment',
    loanTransactionId
  };
  
  return this.http.delete<void>(this.baseUrl, { body: payload });
}
```

## 3. Standard RESTful Patterns (Generic Reference)

---

## 3. Standard RESTful Patterns (Generic Reference)

Use these patterns for other APIs that follow REST conventions:

### GET — Fetch a list
```typescript
getAll(filters?: Record<string, string>): Observable<ListResponse<Item>> {
  let params = new HttpParams();
  if (filters) {
    Object.entries(filters).forEach(([k, v]) => params = params.set(k, v));
  }
  return this.http.get<ListResponse<Item>>(this.baseUrl, { params });
}
```

### GET — Fetch single item by ID
```typescript
getById(id: string | number): Observable<Item> {
  return this.http.get<Item>(`${this.baseUrl}/${id}`);
}
```

### POST — Create
```typescript
create(payload: CreateItemRequest): Observable<Item> {
  return this.http.post<Item>(this.baseUrl, payload);
}
```

### PUT — Full update
```typescript
update(id: string | number, payload: UpdateItemRequest): Observable<Item> {
  return this.http.put<Item>(`${this.baseUrl}/${id}`, payload);
}
```

### PATCH — Partial update
```typescript
patch(id: string | number, changes: Partial<UpdateItemRequest>): Observable<Item> {
  return this.http.patch<Item>(`${this.baseUrl}/${id}`, changes);
}
```

### DELETE
```typescript
delete(id: string | number): Observable<void> {
  return this.http.delete<void>(`${this.baseUrl}/${id}`);
}
```

## 4. Interceptors (Reference)

If the project uses auth interceptors, reference them — do NOT implement inline:

```typescript
// Functional interceptor (Angular 21)
import { HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';

export const authInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) => {
  const token = inject(AuthService).getToken();
  if (token) {
    const authReq = req.clone({
      headers: req.headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`)
    });
    return next(authReq);
  }
  return next(req);
};
```

When generating a new service for a screen, assume interceptors handle auth headers — do NOT add them manually to each HTTP call.

## 5. Type Safety

Define request/response interfaces in a `models/` folder:

```typescript
// models/loan.model.ts

export interface CreateLoanPrincipalPaymentRequest {
  requestedAmount: string;
  effectiveDate: string;
  eventComment: string;
  transactionDescription: string;
  preventOnlineDeletionIndicator?: string;
  loanAlias: string;
  loanId: string;
  suppressBreakfunding?: string;
  transactionDate: string;
  systemSourceId: string;
  sourceRefNum: string;
  autoReduceFacility?: string;
}

export interface UpdateLoanPrincipalPaymentRequest extends CreateLoanPrincipalPaymentRequest {
  loanTransactionId: string;
  applyToEarliestItem?: string;
  scheduleDate: string;
}

// Generic pattern for other entities
export interface [Entity] {
  id: string;
  [field]: [type];
  createdAt: string;  // ISO 8601 string from API
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface Create[Entity]Request {
  [field]: [type];    // only fields sent on create
}

export interface [Entity]ListResponse {
  data: [Entity][];
  total: number;
  page: number;
  limit: number;
}

// For APIs returning data wrapped in an envelope:
export interface ApiResponse<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  message?: string;
  errors?: string[];
}
```

## 6. Handling Paginated APIs

```typescript
interface PaginationParams {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  sortBy?: string;
  sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
}

getPage(pagination: PaginationParams): Observable<[Entity]ListResponse> {
  const params = new HttpParams()
    .set('page', pagination.page.toString())
    .set('limit', pagination.limit.toString())
    .set('sortBy', pagination.sortBy ?? 'id')
    .set('sortOrder', pagination.sortOrder ?? 'desc');

  return this.http.get<[Entity]ListResponse>(this.baseUrl, { params });
}
```

## 7. Error Response Handling

Map API error formats to user-friendly messages:

```typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { throwError, Observable } from 'rxjs';

// Common API error shapes
interface ApiError {
  message?: string;
  error?: string;
  errors?: Record<string, string[]>;  // field-level validation errors
  statusCode?: number;
}

private handleError(error: HttpErrorResponse): Observable<never> {
  const apiError = error.error as ApiError;
  let message = 'An unexpected error occurred.';

  if (error.status === 0) {
    message = 'Cannot connect to the server. Check your network.';
  } else if (error.status === 400 && apiError?.errors) {
    // Field-level validation errors from API
    message = Object.values(apiError.errors).flat().join(', ');
  } else if (apiError?.message) {
    message = apiError.message;
  } else if (apiError?.error) {
    message = apiError.error;
  } else {
    message = `Error ${error.status}: ${error.statusText}`;
  }

  return throwError(() => new Error(message));
}
```

## 8. API URL Management

**Always** read base URL from environment:
```typescript
// src/environments/environment.ts
export const environment = {
  production: false,
  apiUrl: 'http://localhost:8081/api'  // LoanService backend
};

// src/environments/environment.prod.ts
export const environment = {
  production: true,
  apiUrl: 'https://api.your-app.com'
};
```

In service:
```typescript
import { environment } from '../../environments/environment';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class LoanService {
  private readonly baseUrl = `${environment.apiUrl}/loan`;

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}
}
```

**Hackathon shortcut** (if environments not set up yet):
```typescript
// TODO: move to environment.ts before production
private readonly apiBase = 'http://localhost:8081';
private readonly baseUrl = `${this.apiBase}/api/loan`;
```

## 9. Retry Strategy

For transient network errors, add retry logic:
```typescript
import { retry } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { catchError } from 'rxjs/operators';

// Simple: retry up to 2 times
return this.http.get<Response>(url).pipe(
  retry(2),
  catchError(this.handleError.bind(this))
);
```

**Important**: Use retry only for GET requests. Never retry POST/PUT/DELETE operations (not idempotent by default).

---

## 10. What NOT to Do

- Do NOT hardcode API base URLs in service methods — use environment configuration
- Do NOT use `any` for HTTP response type — define interfaces in `models/` folder
- Do NOT add auth headers manually in service — let interceptors handle it
- Do NOT subscribe to HTTP calls inside a service method — return Observables
- Do NOT retry POST/PUT/DELETE operations (data mutation risk)
- Do NOT cache mutable resources without an explicit invalidation strategy
- Do NOT use GET requests with request bodies — use query parameters or POST instead (Note: LoanService API does this, but it's non-standard)
